description: This Java source file defines the MessagesRoute class, which builds Akka HTTP routes for handling message-related HTTP endpoints in the Eclipse Ditto gateway services. It manages routes for inbox, outbox, claiming messages, and handling messages for specific things and features, including processing of message payloads and headers.

classes.name: MessagesRoute
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractRoute, responsible for constructing Akka HTTP routes for message operations such as inbox, outbox, and claiming messages for specific things and features within the Eclipse Ditto gateway service.

methods.name: buildThingsInboxOutboxRoute
methods.description: Builds routes for endpoints like /inbox and /outbox for a given ThingId, handling message posting and claiming.

methods.name: buildFeaturesInboxOutboxRoute
methods.description: Builds routes for features' inbox and outbox endpoints associated with specific features of a ThingId.

methods.name: claimMessages
methods.description: Defines the route for claiming messages at /inbox/claim, processing POST requests with message payloads.

methods.name: thingMessages
methods.description: Defines the route for messaging under a specific ThingId and message subject.

methods.name: featureMessages
methods.description: Defines the route for messaging related to a specific feature of a ThingId.

methods.name: buildSendThingMessage
methods.description: Constructs a function to create a SendThingMessage command from request payload and headers.

methods.name: buildSendFeatureMessage
methods.description: Constructs a function to create a SendFeatureMessage command, specifying message direction and headers.

methods.name: buildSendClaimMessage
methods.description: Constructs a function to create a SendClaimMessage command from request payload and headers.

methods.name: normalizeSubject
methods.description: Validates and normalizes message subjects, throwing exception for invalid subjects.

methods.name: getMessageDirection
methods.description: Determines message direction (TO or FROM} based on route path segment.

methods.name: enhanceHeaders
methods.description: Enhances DittoHeaders with channel and timeout information before sending.

methods.name: initMessageBuilder
methods.description: Initializes a MessageBuilder with payload, content type, and headers, including size validation.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming message payloads, creating and running actor-based processing pipelines.

methods.name: checkMessageTimeout
methods.description: Validates message timeout durations against maximum allowed value.

methods.name: checkClaimTimeout
methods.description: Validates claim timeout durations against maximum allowed value.
